ios.desc:
Welcome to Blinky Bat, a game that transforms your blinks into thrilling gameplay! Drawing inspiration from the classic flappy bird game, Blinky Bat elevates the experience with its unique blink-controlled mechanics. Navigate your bat through a maze of obstacles, timing your blinks to perfection to survive the challenging journey.

Key Features:

→ Intuitive Control: Use your eye blinks to guide the bat, offering a hands-free, immersive gaming experience.
→ Endless Adventure: Fly through an endless landscape of obstacles, striving for the highest score.
→ Simple Yet Challenging: Easy to start but hard to master, Blinky Bat keeps you engaged with its skill-based gameplay.
→ Family-Friendly Fun: Suitable for all ages, providing a quirky twist to game night with a control scheme that's sure to get everyone blinking!

Get ready to blink your way through a captivating world filled with challenges and fun. Download Blinky Bat now and let your eyelids lead you to victory!
